name: Perilunate Dislocation / Perilunate Injury
definition: High-energy carpal injury with perilunate dislocation or fracture-dislocation, frequently associated with median nerve compression and missed on initial assessment.

investigations.principle: Urgent radiographs and CT characterize alignment and fractures.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Most perilunate injuries require reduction and operative stabilization.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Manibandha-bhagna/Sandhi displacement concepts are secondary to emergency modern care.

patientEducation.summary: High-energy carpal injury with perilunate dislocation or fracture-dislocation, frequently associated with median nerve compression and missed on initial assessment.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
